LESSON: DIVISION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers 1.6 Multiplication By the end of the sub-strand, the learner  Learners 
Topic 1.7: Division

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Division
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. divide equal groups
2. check division by multiplying

SECTION 3: PICTURES

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-096.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 96]]

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-082.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 82]]

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-119.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 119]]

SECTION 4: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Division

Teach
• Division shares a total into equal groups.
• Check by multiplying: if 24 ÷ 6 = 4, then 6 × 4 = 24.

Worked example
• 24 ÷ 6 = 4
• 36 ÷ 4 = 9
• 45 ÷ 5 = 9

Try this
• 18 ÷ 3
• 40 ÷ 8
• Share 30 books among 5 learners
• (Check later: 6; 5; 6 each)


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• 24 ÷ 6 = 4
• 36 ÷ 4 = 9
• 30 ÷ 5 = 6

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Work out 18 ÷ 3, 28 ÷ 7, 40 ÷ 8. Multiply to check.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Write 8 division questions and mark them.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Division undoes multiplication.
• Always check by multiplying.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
